title.en: Anthropic IPO: What the S-1 Reveals

excerpt.zh: Anthropic IPO初步文件显示，公司拟发行A类普通股并申请以“ANT”在纳斯达克上市，但价格、股数和生效时间仍未确定。
excerpt.en: Anthropic IPO filings outline a planned Class A share offering and Nasdaq listing, while price, share count, and timing remain unsettled.

text.zh: Anthropic IPO进入公开申报阶段
text.en: Anthropic IPO Moves Into Public Filing

text.zh: Anthropic向美国证券交易委员会提交了S-1注册声明，文件日期为2026年10月26日。Anthropic IPO计划涉及A类普通股，公司已申请在纳斯达克全球精选市场以“ANT”交易；不过，申报文件仍是初步版本，发行尚未完成。
text.en: Anthropic filed an S-1 registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission dated October 26, 2026. The Anthropic IPO concerns Class A common stock, and the company has applied to list on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under “ANT.” The filing is preliminary, so the offering has not been completed.

text.zh: 文件中的发行价格、发行股数、承销折扣和募集金额等关键栏位尚未填定。公司表示，发行生效后才会尽快向公众出售证券；部分现有股东也计划出售额外股份，而这些出售所得不会进入Anthropic。当前文件没有提供可据此判断估值或最终规模的完整数字。
text.en: Key fields for the offering price, share count, underwriting discount, and proceeds are still blank. The company says the public sale would begin as soon as practicable after the registration statement becomes effective. Certain selling stockholders may also sell additional shares, with those proceeds going to the sellers rather than Anthropic. The filing therefore does not yet establish a final valuation or offering size.

text.zh: 公益公司结构带来不同的控制安排
Anthropic以特拉华州公益公司形式运营，章程目标是负责任地开发和维护先进AI，以长期造福人类。其长期利益信托由具备AI安全、国家安全、公共政策和社会企业经验的受托人组成，并通过特别类别股票参与选任和罢免一部分董事。该安排意在把公益目标纳入公司治理，而不只是依赖普通股东回报。
text.en: Anthropic is organized as a Delaware public benefit corporation whose stated purpose includes the responsible development and maintenance of advanced AI for humanity’s long-term benefit. Its Long-Term Benefit Trust is intended to consist of financially disinterested trustees with expertise in areas such as AI safety, national security, public policy, and social enterprise. Through a special share class, the trust would help elect and remove certain directors, embedding the public-benefit purpose in governance.

text.zh: 治理权并不完全由公开交易的A类股决定：创始人相关实体持有的F类股票拟拥有总体投票权的50.1%，用于多数普通董事选举等事项；T类股票则由长期利益信托使用，通常不享有经济权利。文件还将Anthropic视为纳斯达克规则下的“受控公司”。因此，投资者需要继续关注最终条款、注册声明何时生效，以及这种多类别股权结构如何在增长、股东问责与AI安全目标之间取得平衡。
text.en: Voting power would not rest solely with publicly traded Class A shares. A founder-related entity is expected to hold Class F stock carrying 50.1% of the overall voting power for matters such as electing most directors, while Class T stock would be used by the Long-Term Benefit Trust and generally carry no economic rights. The filing also classifies Anthropic as a controlled company under Nasdaq rules. The main open questions are the final terms, the effective date, and how this multi-class structure will balance growth, shareholder accountability, and AI-safety goals.
